title: Cosmic Fortune
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium illustrated slot-game catalogue title card.
Primary request: Create ONE original polished "Cosmic Fortune" key-art image, WIDE 2:1 landscape, opaque.
Scene/backdrop: sweeping electric-cyan and violet nebula clouds against deep navy star fields, a distant softly lit ringed planet. Minimal curved metallic observation-window frame at extreme edges with antique-gold details, matching the game's blue/cyan/violet/gold space identity.
Subject: one sleek retro-futurist silver-and-royal-blue rocket with gold fin trim, a round blue porthole and short bright orange exhaust plume, flying diagonally upward through space. The rocket AND entire short flame together occupy at most 55% of image HEIGHT, fully visible, compact silhouette. No astronaut or new character.
Composition/framing: spacious wide 2:1 illustrated key art. Large two-line title balanced with rocket and planet. Keep ALL title letters and ENTIRE rocket/flame in x12–88%, y18–82%; leave generous dark outer space margins all around. Do NOT enlarge the rocket to fill the canvas. Nebula remains quiet behind title. Planet is secondary and does not obscure words.
Style/medium: sophisticated professionally painted sci-fi game illustration, tangible polished metal, precise fins, restrained cinematic bloom and depth; coherent premium catalogue feel.
Text (verbatim): "Cosmic Fortune". Exactly once, two lines, large cream-gold serif lettering with subtle cool-blue reflected edges, high contrast and legible at 256x128.
Constraints: no extra text/numerals, no slogans, payout promises, reels, buttons, interface, logo or watermark, no unrelated cultural/religious additions. One image only.

visualCheck.fullSize: Inspected master and 768x384 WebP. Exact Cosmic Fortune title. Silver/blue/gold rocket, orange exhaust, ringed planet, cyan/violet nebula and observation-window frame preserve identity. No fake UI, extra words or claims.
visualCheck.thumbnail256x128: Inspected 256x128. Both title words legible and rocket recognizable.
visualCheck.crop: Title, complete rocket body and main flame remain within central 80% width / 70% height. Secondary distant planet and nebula extend toward edges.
